hooks.command: IN=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$CMD" in *python*) FREE=$(memory_pressure -Q 2>/dev/null | awk -F': ' '/free percentage/{gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",$2); print $2}'); if [ -n "$FREE" ] && [ "$FREE" -lt 15 ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"BLOCKED: only %s%% system memory free (<15%% floor). Kill stray project python processes, then retry."}}' "$FREE"; else printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"Memory check: %s%% system-wide free (floor 15%%)."}}' "${FREE:-unknown}"; fi;; esac
hooks.statusMessage: Checking system memory before Python run
